title: Comparison page: Citehound vs other AI-readiness checkers (facts only)
why: People ask for alternatives. A neutral, dated, source-cited comparison earns trust if every cell is verifiable.
body:
INTENT: neutral comparison of public, verifiable facts only: what each tool checks, free vs paid, whether a scan needs sign-up, API/MCP availability. Each cell cites the competitor's public page with the date checked. No claims about quality or results.

NEEDS FROM YOU: the list of competitors to include (I propose to research three to five from public search and bring them back as a list for your approval; none is named here). I do not build until you approve the list.

RISK: any cell that goes stale becomes a wrong claim. Mitigation: a 'checked on' date per row and a quarterly recheck task.
